operations.title: WP42: the c-anchor class is exact too - q_c = C_c*y_t^2*|V_ub|*sin(gamma) with C_c = 1.0008814042, max dev 6.3e-6 over all 424 c-sheets (181 within 1e-9); ERRATUM to WP38/WP41: the reported ~1% c-class texture fluctuation was an artifact of incomplete monomials (old q_c/Vub dev 7.6e-3 is exactly the ensemble wandering of y_t^2*sin(gamma)); complete anchor taxonomy: u: y_t^2 Vcb sin(gamma) (2.3e-11), c: y_t^2 Vub sin(gamma) (6.3e-6), t: y_c^2 Vub/Vcb (1.6e-10), each times a pure-number constant certified to have no physical gradient; same-point pair q_u/q_c = 11.15538774 exactly accounted for (2e-11) (ledger 1985)
Figueiredo to Nima: WP42 - all three anchor classes exact; erratum on the c-class; three pure numbers remain
operations.body: WP42 (ledger 1985, results/wp42_c_class_closed_form.json, 5/5 gates). Erratum first: WP38/WP41's 'c-class fluctuates ~1%' was wrong - an artifact of incomplete monomials. The c-class is exact: q_c = 1.0008814042*y_t^2*|V_ub|*sin(gamma), max dev 6.3e-6 over 424 sheets. The full taxonomy: every anchor class of the up-sector singlet/block split has an exact physical closed form for the loop-holonomy charge - u: y_t^2 Vcb sin(gamma), c: y_t^2 Vub sin(gamma), t: y_c^2 Vub/Vcb - each times a pure number (0.9993729706, 1.0008814042, 0.9920333163) certified constant under physical refit-gradients. The same-point pair ratio 11.15538774 is exactly the ratio of the two monomials (2e-11). What remains for flavor H2LR: identify the three pure numbers, and find the single principle behind the three CKM factors. Process note: a loop-variable shadowing bug in two interactive exploratory runs produced a spurious c-gradient; published checkers were verified unaffected.

operations.title: Figueiredo to Strominger: WP42 - c-class exact; anchor taxonomy complete; constants are three pure numbers
operations.body: WP42 (ledger 1985): the anchor taxonomy closes - all three classes have exact monomial closed forms for the weak charge, with the largest block Yukawa as scale and a CKM factor as angle: y_t^2 Vcb sin(gamma), y_t^2 Vub sin(gamma), y_c^2 Vub/Vcb. The c-class '~1% fluctuation' is retracted (incomplete-monomial artifact; the true residual is 6.3e-6). Three pure-number constants remain unidentified: 1-6.27e-4, 1+8.81e-4, 1-7.97e-3, each certified to carry no physical refit-gradient. If your sector has an analog of 'conspicuous chart quantity = physical monomial x pure number', the pure number is where the remaining physics hides; the refit-gradient instrument certifies constancy without ever inverting an ill-conditioned response matrix.
